description.value:
You tap into the energies of the First World to temporarily change the world around a creature within 30 feet and capture them with a conjured vine, mass of stone, or some other natural feature. The creature must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell] saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes a –5-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until the start of your next turn.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard] and takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until the start of your next turn.

Critical Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Immobilized] and off-guard until the start of your next turn. The creature can attempt to Escape against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, to remove the immobilized condition.
